offers_products.reason: Sells contracting services: fiber construction, engineering, locating, maintenance; no products among its main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Wireline and wireless construction, engineering, underground locating, fulfillment and maintenance services for telecom and utility customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are telecom providers and utilities; in-home installs are contracted by the providers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Telecommunications service providers and electric and gas utilities are the buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat work for major carriers under ongoing service agreements: maintenance, locating, fulfillment and continuing construction programs.

cyclical_demand.reason: Carriers can defer or cut network construction spending, which is the larger part of the work.

big_ticket.reason: Work is done in many small jobs and repeat orders: locates, installs, maintenance, and construction work orders.

people_delivered.reason: Site says it supplies skilled people; crews doing construction and locating are what customers pay for.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large national telecom providers and utilities.

asset_heavy.reason: Labor-based contractor; vehicles and equipment are needed, but growth depends mainly on hiring crews.

notes: Cyclicality and asset intensity are judgement calls; the fleet and equipment needs are moderate.
